question: For Brentuximab-vedotin trials in Multiple Myeloma, extract the trial acronym from the trial name (e.g., KEYNOTE-xxx, CHECKMATE-xxx).
augmented_sql:
SELECT "NCT", "PubMed ID", "Trial name" FROM clinical_trials
WHERE "Name of ICI" = 'Brentuximab-vedotin' AND "Cancer type" = 'Multiple Myeloma';
